desc: Build adjacency list from edges and verify rooting via parent/depth arrays from node 0.
Implement DFS that tracks depth (node count) and weighted distance from root, plus a last-seen map for values along the current path.

Implement sliding window logic: on entering node, adjust start depth based on last occurrence of its value, compute candidate (length, node count), update global best with lexicographic (max length, min nodes).
Handle backtracking correctly: restore last-seen map on exit from each node.
Handle edge cases: single-node paths (length 0, 1 node), duplicate values forcing restart, ties preferring fewer nodes; use iterative DFS or setrecursionlimit for n up to 5*10^4.
Test against both examples plus validate correctness; fixed stack-frame mutation bug by using uniform 6-element mutable list frames with `prev is None` sentinel.
